# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Josie is noted for being quite fat for her age, making her appear unsuitable to play slender roles such as a fairy queen.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)_

## Personality

Josie is malicious, sulky, and sharp-tongued, widely recognized for her disagreeable nature. She displays little imagination and lacks good taste, often flaunting her triumphs in a boastful or defiant manner. Her unpleasant attitude extends to insulting others' looks and making unkind taunts.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c27 P40](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0040), [v1 c33 P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P33](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0033)_

## History

Josie attended Avonlea school, where she was the last of her family line to do so. She frequently engaged in dares with other students, successfully walking the Barrys' board fence with ease before daring Anne Shirley to walk a ridgepole, which resulted in Anne falling and breaking her ankle. During preparation for a school concert, Josie grew sulky over not receiving the role of fairy queen in a dialogue and insulted Jane Andrews and Anne. She later caused a three-month feud with Julia Bell after repeating a rude observation about Julia's bow. Josie won first prize for her knitted lace at the exhibition. She subsequently attended Queen's Academy to pursue Second Class work for education's sake, gaining a reputation there as the sharpest-tongued student in attendance.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 c29 P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c38 P40](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0040)_
